optimized_sql:
WITH d1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 4
      AND d_year = 1999
),
d2 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d_year = 1999
),
d3 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10
      AND d_year = 1999
)
SELECT i_item_id,
       i_item_desc,
       s_store_id,
       s_store_name,
       MAX(store_sales.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       MAX(store_returns.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       MAX(catalog_sales.cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM store_sales
JOIN d1
    ON d1.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN store_returns
    ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = store_returns.sr_customer_sk
   AND store_sales.ss_item_sk = store_returns.sr_item_sk
   AND store_sales.ss_ticket_number = store_returns.sr_ticket_number
JOIN d2
    ON d2.d_date_sk = store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk
JOIN catalog_sales
    ON store_returns.sr_customer_sk = catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk
   AND store_returns.sr_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk
JOIN d3
    ON d3.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk
JOIN store
    ON store.s_store_sk = store_sales.ss_store_sk
JOIN item
    ON item.i_item_sk = store_sales.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
ORDER BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name
LIMIT 100
